dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Razor? What are you doing here? And shouldn't this thing be in Wolvendom?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Fiery woman came to take lupical. I said no.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: She backed down, but then said I would do "just as well."

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: This sword is here for now. I am here to protect it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on, let Paimon get this straight... Alice was planning to bring Boreas here, but you stopped her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So she took the illusion of the sword and left you to guard it instead!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That would make the "Trial of Boreas" the "Trial of Razor" now, wouldn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What would happen if someone tried to claim this sword?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, looks like Paimon's guess was spot on... Don't worry, Razor, no one's gonna take this sword. It's not even real.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alice's scheming claims another victim, huh ... Let's take the photo and get Razor out of here.
